visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair, wearing a black short-sleeved t-shirt, dark trousers, and light-colored work boots, sits on a black folding chair in a well-lit camping equipment store. He looks directly at the camera and gestures with his hands to introduce the products. Behind him, wooden shelves are densely packed with camping accessories like metal cups, lanterns, and tactical bags. To his right sits a khaki-colored camping chair with a quilted pattern. (2) The man stands up slightly to demonstrate the adjustable legs of the khaki chair. He grips the metal legs and extends them individually, showing the different height settings. He then demonstrates the folding mechanism by collapsing the seat upward, highlighting the joints. He points to the CAMPFIRE brand tag on the chair back. (3) The man reaches for a light grey straight knife and brings it very close to the camera lens. He points to the textured handle and the sharp, wide metal blade, rotating it to show its thickness and the etched logo. He holds the knife with his right hand while using his left to gesture at specific design details like the pommel and the AUS8 steel material label.
